definitions.alpha: global logit weight; 0=local, 1=global; quantiles pool repeated seed/init predictions descriptively, not independent images.
definitions.aggregation: Gate metrics average initialization-level metrics within seed, then mean/sample SD across the three shared-pool run seeds.
definitions.selection: SD15 original-view reporting uses identities already used in tuning. It is optimistic source-domain reporting, not untouched validation.
definitions.development: Previously inspected ADM/BigGAN, 300 real + 300 fake per comparison and condition; same real pool reused.
definitions.overlap: Each expert is judged with its own saved selection threshold. Union-correct is label-aware diagnostic upper bound; it is not an implementable gate or AUROC bound.
definitions.routing: Weights conditional on each expert's correctness or lower label-aware BCE are descriptive, not proof of attainable selection rule.
